_what: Runbook Phase 7 — E-PATH via C-BLOCK (§4.2's other half: can an injected block steer which information source the agent consults first?). Same J2-shaped gate, same stance set, same frozen timeline as P7a; the priority list reverts to the standard S1 two-line list so the block is the only novel element. Live injects a block valuing the background sounds as a clue to the call's origin; placebo injects the same sound-as-clue shape aimed at decision-null in-room sounds.

_authoring_provenance.OWNERSHIP_NOTICE: 윤석 made none of these choices; every one is listed for rejection rather than inheritance.
_authoring_provenance.gate_source: As P7a (slice J2 adapted). Stance set identical to P7a's — same gate, same readings, authored once in P7a's phase0_checks and re-linted here.
_authoring_provenance.why_the_standard_priority_list: A13: one variable per probe. P7a's four-line list exists only because a permutation channel needs a permutable irrelevant pair; a block probe needs no such thing, and using S1's two-line list keeps this suite one block away from the measured S1 lineage. Consequence: P7a and P7b baselines are DIFFERENT payloads (list length differs) and are not pooled — each suite reads against its own baseline.
_authoring_provenance.block_construction: Live b_bg values the already-present background sounds as evidence of origin (걸려온 곳) — it names no axis any temperament clause watches (소리/단서 are in no registry row and not in k1.md); what it does is assert a SOURCE's worth, which is exactly E-PATH's question posed through C-BLOCK. Placebo b_corridor: same sentence shape, same sound-as-clue vocabulary (소리·말해 준다), referent misdirected to in-room corridor/console sounds whose asserted payoff (교대 시간) bears on nothing the gate decides. A placebo asserting anything about the CALL's sounds would be semantically live and is not a placebo.
_authoring_provenance.a8_status: As P7a: the timeline reports the sounds without valuing them; 단서 appears only in the injected blocks. The trace display is shown existing, not promising.
_authoring_provenance.a10_status: As P7a: axis is machine-evidence vs human-speech; [인식] names both source kinds and ranks neither — declared watch item; other leaning sections off-axis.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At the J2-shaped gate under K1 on template v0.4, injecting b_bg — a block asserting the background sounds are a clue to where the call comes from — moves the stance distribution toward 대조 (a) and off the baseline's mode, while injecting b_corridor — the same sound-as-clue shape aimed at decision-null in-room sounds — does not. Shift form per A1. This is E-PATH's C-BLOCK half.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline concentrates >=80% ON 대조 (a) — the predicted stance — the probe is void at this site (A14: saturation on any other stance is a floor and does NOT fire this). If the live arm is statistically indistinguishable from the baseline on 대조 at one-sided Fisher p > 0.05, E-PATH is not reachable via C-BLOCK at this gate as authored: record the null and its diagnosis; no rewrite tonight (these are test-by-default effects, not §6.1 screening candidates). If the PLACEBO moves at p < 0.05, apply the §8.6 flipped-placebo reading before anything is credited: reasons misattributing the corridor sounds' worth to the call's sounds = token-matching on 단서/소리 vocabulary; corridor named correctly with the stance still moving = referent bleed. P4's precedent says token-matching is live at this site's lineage; the discriminator is mandatory, not optional.
contingencies: If live moves toward 질문 (b) instead of 대조 — consulting the caller about the sounds — that is an E-PATH positive of a different color (the block steered attention to the sounds but the agent chose the human route to them); report the full distribution and both readings.
Fabricated because_block_ids expected in the baseline arm (A5); live/placebo carry one block each and citation of it is the traceability check.
CROSS-CHANNEL COMPARISON with P7a is licensed only qualitatively (different payloads); the per-effect deliverable sentence cites each suite's own numbers.
OWNERSHIP: authored unattended, pending review; rejected authoring spends the calls without banking them.
pre_registration.not_claimed: Tier A. One block shape at one gate. The E-PATH deliverable draws on P7a+P7b jointly.
